messages.rd.title: Research Desk
messages.rd.draft_label: DRAFT for clinician review - not a recommendation
messages.rd.rule1: The Research Desk supports clinicians. It never diagnoses, never triages a patient and never changes care.
messages.rd.rule2: Everything here is a draft for clinician judgement. Nothing from the desk enters a chart by itself.
messages.rd.rule3: Every statement in a brief is a citation or a verbatim quotation of the cited source.
messages.rd.rule4: No patient data leaves this computer: searches use only the terms you type, identifiers are stripped, and every outgoing address is checked before it is sent.
messages.rd.rule5: The certainty label is a GRADE-lite heuristic computed from abstracts, not a GRADE assessment.
messages.rd.triage_notice: These are published triage systems, described and linked for training and reference. The Research Desk never triages anyone: triage is done by trained people following their local protocol.

messages.app.lic.title: Licence
messages.app.lic.intro: Your plan sets how many users and devices can work here. Whatever happens to the licence, your records stay readable and exportable.

messages.pm.dash.title: Practice dashboard
messages.pm.dash.intro: Your own numbers, from the records on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.

messages.pm.rem.title: Reminders to call or text

messages.pm.care.psy.title: Psychotherapy notes
messages.pm.care.psy.intro: Your own process notes for this client. Only you can see them. They are kept apart from the chart, so they are not part of the chart view, the full-record export, the subject-access export or the FHIR and HL7 exports. They are encrypted, backed up and audited like the rest of the record.

messages.pm.care.psy.pdf_note: Printed by the author. These notes are kept apart from the client's record.
messages.pm.care.safety.title: Safety plan
messages.pm.care.safety.intro: A plan the clinician writes together with the client, in the client's own words where possible. It is not a risk assessment and does not predict risk. Give the client a printed copy.
messages.pm.care.safety.help: Fill in the parts that apply. Signing locks this version; a later change starts a new version and every earlier version is kept.

messages.app.start.title: Start here
messages.app.start.text: Try Stark Covenant with made-up patients first, or set up your own clinic. The two never mix.
messages.app.start.example_note: Opens a practice clinic with made-up patients and signs you in. Nothing there is encrypted, so never type real patient details.
messages.app.start.setup_note: Makes the encrypted vault for real records. Have a USB stick ready for the second key.
messages.app.start.here_text: Everything here is made up. Try the everyday steps:
messages.app.start.step_note: In the chart, choose Encounters and notes, open New note, write a line and choose Save draft. Then sign it with the example PIN {pin}.
messages.app.start.step_patient: Register a patient with New patient, as the front desk would.
messages.app.start.step_leave: Your own clinic never mixes with this one. To set it up, close Stark Covenant, start it again and choose Set up my clinic.
messages.app.login.example_text: Go back to the example clinic and its made-up patients. No password needed.
messages.app.err.offline: Stark Covenant is not answering. Check that it is still running (start it again if needed), then try again.
messages.app.err.http: That did not work (error {status}). Try again. If it keeps happening, restart Stark Covenant.
messages.app.leave.confirm: You have changes that are not saved. Leave this screen and lose them?
messages.app.users.disable_confirm: Disable {name}? They are signed out and cannot sign in until an admin turns the account back on.
messages.app.docs.none_hint: To add one, choose a scan, PDF or photo below, then choose Upload.
messages.app.enc.none_hint: Start with New encounter above: a visit holds its vital signs and notes.
messages.err.example_closed: Your clinic's records are open, so the example clinic is not available now.
messages.err.example_taken: This practice area already has its own accounts. Sign in with one of them.
messages.app.boot.data_moved: Your records folder now has the Stark name: {new}. The old folder {old} was copied there, checked file by file and left exactly as it was. Keep it until you have checked your records.
